title: Appending a symbol to a buffer tape
statement: Let $w$ be a finite word over an alphabet and let $b$ be a symbol in that alphabet. The tape storing $w$ followed by $b$ is the tape storing $w$ updated at integer cell $|w|$ to contain $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a finite word over a symbol type
$b$ is a symbol of that type
replaced:
Let $w$ be a Boolean word and $b$ a Boolean symbol.  The buffer tape storing
$w$ followed by the single symbol $b$ equals the buffer tape storing $w$
updated at cell $\abs{w}$ to hold $b$: exactly the cell that was the old
right blank changes, and every other integer cell is unaffected.
